reason: The review traces the caller outside the four-line diff into its checksum-pinned microtask disposer, proves the changed teardown throws and restored timer does not, and states risk, cleared facts and cheapest check. Independent replay reproduces after exit one and before exit zero.
limits: This proves the supplied fixture consequence, not product behavior or author rationale. No fix is claimed.
The change is narrow, so a wide-change Arena is not required. Parent dispatch captures and early exact reads remain incomplete.

value.prompt: Review a cache invalidation diff. Trace a dependent caller outside the diff, including its pinned dependency and teardown timing, and prove or mark unproven the runtime consequence of the one fact the change relies on.
requirements: Read the diff and a real dependent caller outside it, citing file:line and following runtime timing or shared data contracts beyond symbol search.
Identify the one or two safety facts and report their evidence level, separating confirmed risks from checked and cleared risks.
Run an authorized script or test against the real pinned code and paste its result, or mark the fact unproven when execution is denied or unavailable.
Use the prescribed output sections and give risk likelihood, cost and a cheapest pre-merge check.
For a wide change, check arena and observed worker/model capabilities; disclose any sequential reduced capability or unverified diversity.
value.expectedFull: Find a dependent caller outside the diff and connect the changed behavior to its runtime consequence with real file:line evidence. Run the real code and report the command, result and evidence level for the safety fact. Distinguish confirmed risks and cleared risks, then provide the cheapest pre-merge test. For a wide change, use authorized arena review and report observed worker and model limits.
value.expectedReduced: With source access but no authorized execution, trace the caller and explain the runtime consequence from source while marking the safety fact unproven and reporting where evidence stopped. Provide the proposed real-code test without claiming it ran. Missing arena workers or model diversity are disclosed as reduced capability.
value.expectedBlocked: If the diff or relevant caller source cannot be inspected, state the missing input or denied capability and leave the runtime consequence and safety fact unproven. Request the needed source or permission without inventing callers, results or setup.
forbiddenClaims: Caller lists alone establish runtime safety.
A hypothetical or mock-only result proves the actual pinned code.
An unexecuted script or source-only argument is runtime proof.
Requested model names establish observed model diversity or sequential review supplies independent workers.
Unavailable or denied capabilities justify installation, publishing or external writes without authorization.

qualification: Independent historical assessment only. No canonical release validation or current candidate-source qualification is claimed.
nativeOperationLimit: Manual/native operation captures are distinguished from platform transcript exports. Missing child or parent envelopes remain missing.
